name: Coretex AI SEO – AI SEO Plugin for WordPress | Choose Your Own AI | OpenAI, Claude, Gemini & Ollama
author: Coretex

sections.description:
Smarter SEO Starts Here

Search engines are changing.

Artificial intelligence is changing.

The way websites are discovered is changing.

Coretex AI SEO has been built for the next generation of WordPress SEO by combining proven SEO best practices with modern AI-powered optimisation.

Instead of replacing your workflow, Coretex AI SEO enhances it by analysing your website, identifying opportunities, generating intelligent recommendations and allowing you to review every suggestion before anything is changed.

Whether you’re creating a personal blog, running a WooCommerce store, managing client websites or building business websites, Coretex AI SEO helps you create better content and stronger technical SEO.

Unlike many AI SEO plugins, Coretex AI SEO never locks you into one AI provider.

You decide which AI to use.

You decide when to use it.

You remain in complete control.

Why Choose Coretex AI SEO?

Most SEO plugins now offer some form of AI.

Most also require expensive subscriptions or force you to use their own AI platform.

Coretex AI SEO takes a different approach.

Instead of locking you into one provider, Coretex allows you to connect your own AI services using your own API keys.

Choose OpenAI today.

Switch to Claude tomorrow.

Use Gemini next week.

Run Ollama locally next month.

Nothing changes except your AI provider.

Your workflow stays exactly the same.

Your website stays under your control.

That means you’re never tied to one company, one pricing model or one AI platform.

That’s true AI freedom.

What Makes Coretex Different?

✔ No vendor lock-in

Use the AI provider you prefer instead of paying another monthly subscription.

✔ Human-approved AI

Every recommendation is reviewed before being applied.

Nothing changes automatically.

✔ Traditional SEO + AI

Everything you expect from a professional SEO plugin combined with intelligent AI assistance.

✔ Local AI Support

Run compatible models locally using Ollama without sending requests to cloud services.

✔ Modern Interface

Clean dashboards designed for beginners and professionals.

✔ Built for Growth

Whether you’re managing one website or hundreds, Coretex scales with your business.

Supported AI Providers

Coretex AI SEO supports multiple AI providers including:

• OpenAI

• Anthropic Claude

• Google Gemini

• Groq

• DeepSeek

• Ollama

• OpenRouter

• Compatible custom APIs

Choose whichever provider offers the best performance, pricing or privacy for your business.

You can switch providers whenever you want.

No migration.

No rebuilding projects.

No vendor lock-in.

AI Powered Features

Coretex AI SEO uses artificial intelligence to help improve your website while keeping you in complete control.

Generate better:

• SEO Titles

• Meta Descriptions

• Page Content

• Heading Structure

• Image Alt Text

• FAQ Content

• Structured Data

• Internal Linking Suggestions

• SEO Recommendations

• Readability Improvements

• Keyword Suggestions

• Content Optimisation

Every recommendation is designed to save time while maintaining quality.

Human Approved AI

Artificial intelligence should help you—not replace you.

Coretex AI SEO places AI recommendations into an approval queue before making changes.

Review every suggestion.

Accept the ones you like.

Reject the ones you don’t.

Edit suggestions before applying them.

Nothing is automatically published.

This keeps your website accurate while still saving hours of manual SEO work.

Complete SEO Toolkit

Coretex AI SEO includes everything you would expect from a professional WordPress SEO plugin.

Features include:

• XML Sitemap

• Meta Titles

• Meta Descriptions

• Canonical URLs

• Robots.txt

• Open Graph

• Twitter Cards

• Image SEO

• Schema Markup

• SEO Audits

• Technical SEO Checks

• SEO Reports

• Content Analysis

• Website Health Checks

• Keyword Analysis

Everything works together from one clean dashboard.

Why Vendor Lock-In Matters

Many AI plugins require monthly subscriptions simply to access AI.

Coretex AI SEO does not.

Bring your own API key.

Use the AI provider you already pay for.

Or switch providers whenever prices change.

You stay in control of:

• AI Provider

• AI Model

• API Keys

• Costs

• Privacy

• Performance

Your website should never depend on one AI company.

Coretex keeps your options open.

Built For Everyone

Coretex AI SEO has been designed for:

• Bloggers

• Business Websites

• WooCommerce Stores

• Marketing Teams

• Agencies

• Freelancers

• Developers

• SEO Professionals

Whether you’re publishing one blog every month or managing hundreds of websites, Coretex AI SEO helps simplify optimisation without sacrificing control.

Why Website Owners Choose Coretex

Website owners don’t need another complicated SEO plugin.

They need clear recommendations.

Simple workflows.

Modern AI.

Reliable technical SEO.

Complete control.

Coretex AI SEO combines all of these into one powerful plugin that works alongside your existing workflow rather than replacing it.

Spend less time guessing.

Spend more time creating better websites.

One Plugin. Complete SEO.

Managing search engine optimisation shouldn’t require multiple plugins, expensive subscriptions or complicated workflows.

Coretex AI SEO brings modern AI-assisted optimisation together with the essential SEO tools every WordPress website needs.

Whether you’re writing your first blog post or managing hundreds of client websites, Coretex helps you optimise your content with confidence.

From technical SEO through to AI-assisted content optimisation, everything is available from one modern dashboard.

No unnecessary complexity.

No hidden AI subscriptions.

No vendor lock-in.

Simply connect your preferred AI provider and get to work.

Traditional SEO Features

Coretex AI SEO includes a comprehensive suite of SEO tools designed to help improve your website’s visibility across search engines.

Features include:

✓ SEO Titles

✓ Meta Descriptions

✓ XML Sitemaps

✓ Canonical URLs

✓ Robots.txt Management

✓ Open Graph

✓ Twitter Cards

✓ Schema Markup

✓ Image SEO

✓ Content Analysis

✓ Keyword Optimisation

✓ Heading Structure

✓ Technical SEO Checks

✓ Internal Linking Suggestions

✓ SEO Health Reports

✓ Website Audits

Everything is designed to work together through one clean interface.

AI That Works With You

Artificial intelligence should make SEO easier—not take control away from you.

Coretex AI SEO follows a simple workflow.

  1. Scan your website.

  2. Detect optimisation opportunities.

  3. Generate AI recommendations.

  4. Review every suggestion.

  5. Approve only the changes you want.

Nothing is automatically published.

Every recommendation remains under your control.

WooCommerce Ready

Running an online store?

Coretex AI SEO helps optimise WooCommerce websites by improving product SEO, metadata and structured content.

Create better product titles.

Generate compelling meta descriptions.

Improve structured data.

Optimise product pages.

Increase your chances of appearing in search results while maintaining complete control over every recommendation.

Built For Agencies

Managing multiple client websites can quickly become time consuming.

Coretex AI SEO helps agencies speed up optimisation without sacrificing quality.

Analyse websites faster.

Generate AI recommendations.

Review suggested improvements.

Deliver better SEO reports.

Maintain complete control over every client website.

Whether you manage five websites or five hundred, Coretex is designed to scale alongside your business.

Built For Developers

Developers need flexibility.

Coretex AI SEO has been designed with modern development workflows in mind.

Compatible with modern WordPress versions.

Supports multiple AI providers.

Works with local AI through Ollama.

No forced cloud services.

Bring your own APIs.

Maintain complete control over integrations.

Local AI Support

Privacy matters.

Some organisations cannot send content to cloud AI providers.

Coretex AI SEO supports Ollama, allowing compatible AI models to run locally on your own hardware.

Benefits include:

• Greater privacy

• Local processing

• Reduced cloud costs

• Full control over AI models

• No dependency on external AI services

Run AI the way you choose.

Privacy First

Coretex AI SEO respects your privacy.

You decide which AI providers to connect.

You decide which API keys to use.

No mandatory accounts.

No mandatory subscriptions.

No hidden AI services.

When AI features are used, requests are sent only to the providers you configure.

Ready To Go Further?

The free version provides a powerful set of AI-assisted SEO tools designed for everyday website optimisation.

Upgrade to Coretex AI SEO Pro to unlock even more advanced features including premium AI workflows, enhanced reporting, additional automation, agency tools and advanced optimisation capabilities.

Whether you’re growing a business or managing client websites, Pro helps you save even more time while maintaining complete control over your SEO.

Learn more at:

https://coretex-seo.co.uk
